statement: Rule 701 exempts offers and sales of securities by a non-reporting issuer under a written compensatory benefit plan (such as a stock option plan) up to, in any consecutive 12-month period, the greatest of $1,000,000, 15% of the issuer's total assets, or 15% of the outstanding amount of the class; once aggregate sales in such a period exceed $10,000,000 the issuer must deliver additional disclosure, including financial statements dated within 180 days (17 CFR § 230.701(b), (d)(2), (e)).
caveat: Exceeding the $10,000,000 threshold without delivering the § 230.701(e) disclosure before sale (for options, before exercise in the SEC's view) loses the exemption for those sales. State-law exemptions for compensatory issuances are separate. This repo does not compute the caps.
